'''TC-4''' was a red [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels" /> TC-4 was programmed with vast knowledge of the [[Currency/Legends|money]] loving culture of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] and served the Swokes Swokes delegate to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Secret Life of Droids" />
